name: Corpse Burner
biography: The Corpse Burner began life as one of the many orphans raised on the ghoulish grounds of the Necropolis - the Würstreich’s City of the Dead - a land of ruined graves & old bones watched over by the macabre monks of the Holy Order.

As the shadowy hand of the Necromancer passed over the land & the dead became fuel for unholy experiments, the orphans of the Order were charged with digging up the dead & burning the flesh from their bones. These charred bones were then collected & sent to the Holy Order to be etched with holy symbols & enshrined into the Gothic arches of the Necropolis.

Dreaming of the wonders of the outside world, the Corpse Burner started his own collection from the jewelry & gold teeth sent with the dead, saving a secret stash to one day escape his miserable lot in life & leave the Necropolis far behind... if only the stash had been as secret as he’d thought!
